title: About Subscriptions
description: Subscriptions are a way for a creator's most engaged followers to support them. When a creator offers Subscriptions, their followers can sign up to access exclusive perks and content. Subscribers receive badges on their replies to the person they’ve Subscribed to, letting them stand out in the conversation.

runs: Subscriptions offer the option to pay for access to bonus content, exclusive previews, and perks as a way to support and connect with people you follow on >x<.
Anyone who lives in a region where Subscriptions are available can purchase a Subscription from >x<.
How do I find people who have a Subscription offering?
Find them by looking for the Subscribe button on their profile.
People who have a Subscription offering choose what bonus content they share. Subscriptions benefits include:
In addition to the regular posts a creator posts, you’ll also see posts in your Home timeline posted exclusively for Subscribers to interact with and reply to.
Notification of exclusive posts (iOS and Android only):
Subscribers on posts for iOS and Android also have the option to set up exclusive post notifications so they get notified when new Subscriptions posts are posted.
Participate in live, Subscribers-only conversations hosted by the person(s) you Subscribe to. You’ll join these Subscriber-only Spaces as a listener who can request to speak in the Space.

Creators can now choose to limit replies on their public posts to only their subscribers. Creators’ posts will still be public, but only people with an active subscription to the creator can reply to the post.

When you reply to a Subscriptions posts, a public badge next to your display name in the reply will identify you as a Subscriber. Anyone can see this badge, but if you’re on >x< for iOS or Android, you can choose to hide the badge from your replies to a Creator’s public posts by turning the setting off.

Even when this setting is turned off, your Subscriber badge will still appear to other Subscribers when you reply to Subscribers-only posts. The creator will always be able to see their Subscribers. This setting is on by default.

Navigate to the profile of the person you Subscribe to, and select their Subscriptions tab. This tab lets you see all of someone’s Subscription posts in one place, and you’ll have access to it for as long as you’re Subscribed.
Creators on 𝕏 can opt to allow messages from their subscribers, however this feature is off by default and may be disabled again at any time.
Who sees Subscriptions conversations and replies?
Subscriptions posts and replies to them are only seen by other Subscribers of that creator. Non-subscribers will only be able to see previews of the Subscriptions posts, but not the replies.

Subscribers can quote or repost Subscriptions posts, but when they do, non-Subscribers only see a preview of the post. Instead, they’ll need to subscribe to the creator in order to see Subscriptions posts.
Can I Subscribe to more than one person?

Yes. Visit the profiles of the people you want to Subscribe to, and tap or click Subscribe to learn more about what they offer and purchase their specific Subscription from >x<. Each Subscription is a separate purchase.
If you ever need to cancel, you'll do so the same way you purchased the Subscription.
A creator sets the monthly price of their Subscription offering by choosing from one of the price points.
How much of my Subscription fee supports the person I Subscribe to?

Creators are eligible to earn up to ~97% of the gross revenue earned from Subscriptions. >x< does not take a revenue share. Any deductions are third-party payment processing or app store fees, as well as cancellations or refunds.
Does >x< or the person I Subscribe to get my payment information when I purchase a Subscription offering?

Subscriptions are purchased from >x<. So when you purchase a Subscription, >x< will receive a receipt of the transaction that includes some information about your purchase, including the last four digits of the card number used to complete the purchase. The person you Subscribe to won’t see your payment details or credit card information.
In addition, when you make a purchase on the web, >x< collects certain elements about you in the embedded form you fill out, while the remaining data is collected by Stripe, our payment partner.
Can I try Subscriptions for free?
We aren’t offering free trials of Subscriptions at this time.
Are Subscriptions available on iOS, Android, and web?
Subscriptions are available for purchase globally on iOS, Android and web.
If I have more than one >x< account, will I see my Subscriptions from all of my accounts?
Only one of your >x< accounts can Subscribe to access and see bonus content from a specific Subscriptions’ profile.

When you make an in-app purchase, your Apple ID or Google Account (as applicable) is limited to a single purchase of a specific Subscription. If you live in a region where web purchase is available, you'll do so through our payment partner, Stripe, which is also limited to a single purchase of a specific Subscription.
How do I Subscribe to someone’s exclusive content?
There are three ways to sign up for Subscriptions:
1. Navigate to the >x< profile you’d like to Subscribe to.
2. If that person has a Subscription offering, and you already follow them, select the
button in the top right corner of their profile.
If that person has a Subscription offering, and you don’t already follow them, select the
button in the top right corner of their profile. You’ll see a preview of the type of bonus content they may offer, and the Subscription price.
to accept the terms and complete your Subscription purchase with >x<.
Any Subscriptions links shared with you will take you directly to the Subscription page for that creator.
Subscriber-only content is visible under a creator’s profile feed and can appear on Home Timeline with a preview and button to subscribe. Simply click on the button and follow the steps to subscribe.
How does my >x< experience change if I don’t pay for Subscriptions?
Subscriptions are an optional purchase, and meant for people looking for more ways to support their favorite voices on >x<.
If someone has a Subscription offering and you don’t purchase the Subscription, you’ll continue to see their regular posts by

How do I cancel a Subscription?

You’ll manage or cancel your Subscription from the platform where you initially signed up. Uninstalling your app or deactivating your account doesn't automatically cancel your Subscription. All cancellations must be carried out through the platform you used to buy the Subscription. For example, if you purchased your Subscription from >x< on:
: you must carry out your cancellation on >x< for iOS or through
you must carry out your cancellation on your Android device, or by contacting
you must carry out your cancellation from the creator's profile page. Log in to your >x< account and navigate to the profile page of the creator you Subscribe to. Select
Subscriptions purchased on x.com will automatically cancel if you deactivate your account.

To avoid further charges, cancel your Subscription at least 24 hours before the auto-renewal period. Canceling won’t give you a refund for amounts already paid. Your access to bonus content from the person you Subscribe to expires at the end of the billing cycle.

Turning off auto-renew on your iOS / Android devices’ app purchasing platform prevents billing for the next payment period, and also Unsubscribes you, but won’t refund your purchase. Similarly, when you purchase a Subscription to someone through our payment partner Stripe on x.com, choosing to Cancel your plan prevents billing for the next payment period, and also Unsubscribes you, but won’t refund your purchase.
For people living in the EU or UK, you can find Apple's and Google's respective cancellation instructions, related refund policies and model cancellation forms for the
Subscriptions, including those linked to suspended >x< accounts, or accounts that you lost access to for any other reason, are non-refundable, unless required by law.
I Subscribed to the wrong person, can I transfer my Subscription?

If you Subscribed to the wrong person's Subscriptions offering, you’ll need to cancel your Subscription with >x<, then Subscribe to the correct profile. All Subscriptions are non-refundable, unless required by law, including Subscriptions purchased in error.
What if the creator I Subscribe to stops their Subscription offering?

If the person you Subscribe to ever deactivates their Subscription offering, we’ll cancel your Subscription and you won’t be charged for the following month. All purchases are non-refundable, including payments for a Subscription canceled or
in the middle of a billing cycle.
What happens if my Subscription payment doesn’t go through?
When the payment provider processes your initial Subscription purchase, and/or monthly renewal, they’ll try completing the transaction up to 3 times.
If you believe you have sufficient funds to complete your transaction, but are still experiencing issues, review the list below to see some reasons why your transaction might get declined:
Did you enter the correct credit card details?
Did you enter the correct address, zip code or postal code?
set on your account by >x< (limits reset daily)?
Does your card issuer limit internet transactions? If so, please contact your bank or credit card provider?
Have you used a proxy or VPN to access >x<? Your bank may have an IP verification system that may restrict your purchases. Please contact your bank to see why your card was declined.
Did you turn off auto-renew for your Subscription?
Still having trouble? Get more help
How will you bill me for my Subscriptions?
Subscriptions are billed monthly through the payment provider you signed up with at the time of purchase. Billing happens around the same date each month.
How do I change my payment method, payment date or billing information for my Subscription?
Your Subscriptions automatically renew on or around the same date each month. You’ll manage your billing and payment information through whatever platform you used to buy your Subscription.
Content issues, error messages, and bugs
Why can’t I access my Subscriptions content?

It might take a few minutes for your Subscriptions to become available. If you continue to have issues, cancel your Subscription, log in to your account and Resubscribe. You won’t get charged again, and this should activate your Subscription.
What should I do if the person I Subscribe to isn’t creating any Subscriptions content?

Subscriptions are designed to support your favorite voices on >x<. The bonus content people offer is the full responsibility of people who have the Subscriptions offering. If the person you’re supporting isn’t providing the perks listed on their Subscriptions preview page, we suggest contacting them directly. If that doesn’t help, you can

What happens to my Subscriptions if my >x< account was suspended ?

A >x< suspension or locked account will not automatically cancel your Subscriptions. You’ll need to cancel your Subscription through the platform you Subscribed from to avoid any further charges. For example, if you purchased your Subscription on >x< for iOS, you must carry out your cancellation on >x< for iOS.
If you signed up on x.com with our payment partner, Stripe, and your >x< account gets suspended, your Subscription is automatically canceled.
Subscriptions are non-refundable, unless required by law, even if the >x< account you purchased the Subscription for is suspended for any reason.
The person I Subscribe to had their account suspended, what should I do?

If the >x< account of the person you Subscribe to gets suspended, deleted, or removed from >x<, your Subscription will be canceled, and you’ll no longer be charged. You’ll receive a notification alerting you that your Subscription has been canceled.
The person I Subscribe to blocked my account, does that mean my Subscription is canceled?

No. If you are blocked by the person you Subscribed to, you’ll get a notification letting you know that you can no longer access their Subscription offering, and should unsubscribe. Since you aren’t automatically Unsubscribed, you’ll need to cancel your Subscription from the platform you Subscribed through to avoid any further charges.
Where do I find my Subscriptions exclusive content?

When someone you Subscribe to posts exclusive content for their Subscribers, it’ll appear on your Home timeline. The content also appears on their profile under the "Subs" tab and the main "Posts" tab.
How do I set up notifications for Subscriptions content?

Subscriptions on >x< for iOS and Android can set up notifications so they will be notified when the people they Subscribe to post exclusive content. To set up these notifications from >x< for iOS and Android:
Navigate to the profile of the person you Subscribe to.
Select the Subscribe button on their profile.
The Account notification section shows all the notification options. Select Subscriber-only posts as well as any other notifications you wish to activate.
You will now receive notifications when the person you Subscribe to posts exclusive Subscriptions content.
Where do I find my Subscriber badge?
After you purchase a Subscription, a Subscriber badge will appear next to your name on all of your replies to posts by the person you Subscribe to.

If you’re on >x< for iOS and Android, you can change who can see your badge in your Subscription settings by selecting the Subscriptions button on each of the creator’s profiles that you Subscribe to. When toggled off, the badge on your replies to a creator’s public posts will be hidden from everyone except the creator. Your replies to the creator’s Subscription posts will still be badged, and the creator and their Subscribers will be able to see the badge.
If I Subscribe to more than one person, do I get multiple badges?
A single Subscriber badge will appear by your name on your replies to posts by the people you Subscribe to. This badge isn’t specific to any one Subscription, and you won’t see multiple badges.
